_doc: Minimal IC strong-signal config — May 3 2026. After ablation showed max_pain/adj_threshold/intraday_vix_spike are pure noise (Δ WF mean_test_sharpe = 0.0 each), this config keeps ONLY the 3 filters that pulled real weight: score>=85, PCR 0.85-1.20, vol_scaled_exits. Predicted WF mean_test_sharpe ≈ 2.184 (matches baseline within noise). 50%% fewer tuned parameters = lower curve-fit risk = better holdout chances.
